shared_positive: Wide full-body shot, camera locked. Character small and centered, about 50 percent of frame height. Large empty black margin above the head, at least 20 percent of the frame. Top of the head well below the top edge, both feet fully visible above the bottom edge. Not cropped, not a close-up.
negative: cropped, cut off head, cut off hair, head touching the top edge, cut off feet, feet touching the bottom edge, close-up, tight framing, zoomed in, portrait crop
